question.text: Direct plan option for PMS clients means:

answer.text: Same fee whether on-boarded through a distributor or directly
No distributor commission; clients pay lower net cost when onboarding directly
Applies only to Cat II AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates a Direct Plan option where clients onboarding without distributor avoid commission load. The Trap: Direct plans are for all retail/HNI PMS clients; not restricted to AIF Cat II. Cross-Exam Context: Aligned with XIX-A, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always inform the client about the Direct option up front — failure risks SEBI action.
